intent: End-to-end request-path slice of the turn completed history consumer on embedded H2, each case seeding a UNIQUE session id: a valid event appends user message and assistant reply rows once (AZ-06 permitted); redelivery adds zero rows; an unauthenticated event is dropped and audited; a valid event whose tenant mismatches the session is dropped and audited (cross-owner).

methods.signature: Mono<Void> consume(String serviceId, String secret, String sessionId, String turnId, String userId, String tenantId, int userSequence, String userMessage, int userTokens, int replySequence, String assistantReply, int replyTokens)
methods.semantics: event dropped, never thrown, when credential or tenant check fails
